lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The user named a local executable for the CLI. Use that command as written everywhere SKILL.md and its references run the pinned `npx` command.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: In the step-2 shell call, run `<executable> --version` in place of `npm view comprehende version`. That printed line is the CLI version, and the step-2c version check compares it with the pin.
